description: Create course workflow service for assignment and execution management
steps: Create src/services/course-workflow-service.ts
Implement getActiveWorkflowForCourse(courseId) - returns CourseWorkflow with template and steps
Implement getCourseWorkflowsForWorkflow(workflowTemplateId) - list courses using this workflow
Implement assignWorkflowToCourse(courseId, workflowTemplateId) - creates CourseWorkflow
Implement unassignWorkflowFromCourse(courseWorkflowId) - deletes CourseWorkflow and related executions
Implement updateCourseWorkflowStatus(courseWorkflowId, status) - pause/resume/complete
Implement checkAndUpdateWorkflowCompletion(courseWorkflowId) - mark as completed if all executions done
Verify with pnpm lint
Verify with pnpm typecheck
Create src/services/workflow-execution-service.ts
Import helper to calculate scheduledAt (will be created in next task)
Implement generateExecutionsForEnrollment(enrollmentId, courseWorkflowId) - creates WorkflowExecution for each step
Implement generateExecutionsForAllEnrollments(courseWorkflowId) - bulk create for existing enrollments
Implement markPastExecutionsAsSkipped(courseWorkflowId) - mark executions with scheduledAt < now as 'skipped'
Implement getPendingExecutions(limit) - get executions ready to send (status=pending, scheduledAt <= now)
Implement getUpcomingExecutionsForCourse(courseWorkflowId) - next N scheduled emails for preview
Implement getExecutionHistoryForCourse(courseWorkflowId) - sent/skipped executions
Verify with pnpm lint
Verify with pnpm typecheck

description: Create scheduler helper for calculating scheduledAt based on trigger types
steps: Create src/services/workflow-scheduler.ts
Import date-fns for date calculations
Implement calculateScheduledAt(step, course) - main function that routes to specific calculators
Handle triggerType: course_start - course.startDate + offset days
Handle triggerType: course_end - course.endDate + offset days
Handle triggerType: exam_date - course.examDate + offset days (return null if no examDate)
Handle triggerType: class_date - course.classDates[triggerClassIndex-1] + offset days
Handle triggerType: registration_deadline - course.registrationDeadline + offset days
Return null if base date is missing or invalid
Add helper shouldSkipExecution(scheduledAt) - returns true if scheduledAt is in the past
Verify with pnpm lint
Verify with pnpm typecheck

description: Extend enrollment service to generate workflow executions on enrollment creation
steps: Open src/services/enrollment-service.ts
Import generateExecutionsForEnrollment from workflow-execution-service
Import getActiveWorkflowForCourse from course-workflow-service
Modify createEnrollment function to check for active workflow after creating enrollment
If course has active workflow (status=active), call generateExecutionsForEnrollment
Ensure workflow generation happens inside the same transaction or right after
Handle errors gracefully - enrollment should succeed even if workflow generation fails (log error)
Verify with pnpm lint
Verify with pnpm typecheck
Create src/services/workflow-email-service.ts
Import renderTemplate and sendEmail helpers from existing email-service
Import Resend client configuration
Implement processWorkflowExecution(executionId) - renders template and sends email
Fetch execution with student, course, educator data for variable replacement
Mark execution as 'sending' before send attempt
On success: update status to 'sent', set sentAt, save resendId
On failure: update status to 'failed', save errorMessage
Implement processPendingWorkflowExecutions(limit) - batch process pending executions
Add delay between sends to respect Resend rate limits (100ms between each)
Verify with pnpm lint
Verify with pnpm typecheck

description: Create server actions for workflow assignment to courses
steps: Create src/app/educator/courses/[id]/workflows/actions.ts
Define Zod schema for assignWorkflow: { workflowTemplateId: string }
Implement assignWorkflowAction(courseId, formData) - validates ownership, assigns workflow
After assignment, call generateExecutionsForAllEnrollments for existing students
Call markPastExecutionsAsSkipped to handle already-past dates
Implement unassignWorkflowAction(courseWorkflowId) - validates ownership, removes assignment
Implement pauseWorkflowAction(courseWorkflowId) - sets status to paused
Implement resumeWorkflowAction(courseWorkflowId) - sets status to active
Add revalidatePath for course pages after mutations
Verify with pnpm lint
Verify with pnpm typecheck

description: Create server actions for assigning courses from workflow page

Implement assignCourseToWorkflowAction(workflowId, formData) - validates ownership
Call assignWorkflowToCourse from service
Generate executions for all existing enrollments in that course
Mark past executions as skipped
Implement unassignCourseAction(courseWorkflowId) - validates ownership and removes
Add revalidatePath for /educator/workflows and /educator/workflows/[id]
